notes: From v3-cycle-expression-1 (docs/v3/cycles/expression-1.md), class planned. Round-0 builders lost points where the 2.x references taught nothing or steered wrong; carry these into the v3 references this row writes, each serving two or more cases: (1) colour budget: neutral by default, one accent, one status hue; a part-of-whole or a category split is not a reason for a hue each, and a sequential ramp starts neutral below its threshold (findings expression-1.4, .17, .46, .54; catalogue.md part-of-whole row and encoding-rules.md "colour follows the entity" led to rainbows in c06 and n05 and a red-at-0% ramp in c02). (2) Baseline as geometry or a signed delta for every headline value, including against a limit (expression-1.3, .16, .38). (3) Annotate the mark that matters and label marks directly with engine text marks; show one worked text-mark example, since no shipped text does (expression-1.6, .37; c01 and c04 could not find the mark options and dropped direct labels). (4) Anatomy: headline figures in ChartCard facts, the status as a dot and word, a card action in the card, not the page bar (expression-1.21, .31, .42, .49). (5) States copy: say once what is missing and what to do; never repeat the same sentence per cell (expression-1.33). (6) Copy: no repeated qualifier, keep the subject out of a clipping caption (expression-1.29, .35). (7) A fixture shows its zero and its extreme at rest (expression-1.9, .32). (8) Honest marks: a legend entry for every fill a mark uses, a step caption, a size key for a size channel (expression-1.18, .55). (9) One tab stop per visualization (expression-1.23). (10) Responsive: keep the column that carries the answer at 390 and put the answer above the fold (expression-1.12, .63). Also: encoding-rules.md says tabular-nums only in table columns and ticks, which the expression rubric K4 contradicts (expression-1.52); settle it with the owner before writing the typography rule.
